newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 RISES 9.01 PCT,M2 UP 15.68 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 RISES 9.01 PCT,M2 UP 15.68 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply rose to 168.2 billion levs on November 22 from 154.3 billion levs on November 15 and M2 increased to 974.4 billion levs from 861.3 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money rose 13.9 percent to 1,023.7 billion levs as lev-denominated broad money edged up 2.21 percent to 526.1 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money rose 29.55 percent to 497.6 billion levs.
Hard currency-denominated deposits of companies totalled $784.5 million on November 22, down $72 million from November 15.
Individuals alone withdrew some $18 million worth of foreign currency denominated deposits last week, bringing the total to $540 million on November 22.
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals fell to 301.1 billion levs on November 22 from 304.3 billion levs a week earlier. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
